description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000], [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 4] and [Forbidden Incantation Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 4
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next 4 attacks

description.name: Forbidden Incantation Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Forbidden Incantation after using three Dark abilities
